description: This file defines the HomeFragment class, which manages the main home screen UI for an Android TV app. It includes setup for top navigation via Compose, hero banner, 'Continue Watching' and TV channels rails, focus management, loading/error handling, and navigation routing.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main class representing the home screen fragment handling layout, focus, and data display for an Android TV app.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates and sets up the fragment's view hierarchy, including Compose top nav, hero banner, and sections.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets initial focus and observes ViewModel state changes.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Restores focus when returning to the fragment.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Sets LiveData observers to update UI upon data load or errors.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for Continue Watching.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for Continue Watching.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for TV Channels.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for TV Channels.

methods.name: showErrorWithRetry
methods.description: Shows an error message and triggers retry.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populates the Continue Watching rail with data.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Populates the TV channels rail with data.

methods.name: addComposeTopNavBar
methods.description: Adds the Compose-based top navigation bar with focus and input handling.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Creates and configures the hero banner section.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Creates the 'Seguí viendo' horizontal scroll section.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Creates the 'Canales de TV' horizontal scroll section.

methods.name: setRailsFocusable
methods.description: Enables or disables focus for the rails based on user interaction.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Utility to convert density-independent pixels to actual pixels.
